## Description
NoBossNoWait by mrchous but only host needs mod. All credit to mrchous

If you don't need this feature, use the original mod at https://thunderstore.io/package/mrchous/NoBossNoWait/

## Features
* Skips teleporter charging phase after killing boss and adds time that charging would have taken to timer.
* Mod is server-side, so only host needs it installed

## Feedback
* If you wish to leave feedback or report bugs, please do so via discord message to oakprime
